notes: Class A trades on Nasdaq as GRAB (directly, not as ADSs). Counts are from the interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the latest filing with a share count; it states them in thousands, so the shares are rounded to the nearest thousand. 'In issue at June 30' excludes the 16,076 thousand Class A shares held in treasury (the report adds them back to reach 3,989,593 thousand fully paid). The Class B figure includes 12,564 thousand restricted Class B shares issued but not fully vested. The 25,999,981 Class A shares issuable on warrants (at January 31, 2026) and the convertible notes are excluded. The FY2025 20-F count (3,972,725,983 Class A and 127,755,800 Class B at January 31, 2026) is older; since then Grab has bought back shares under its $500 million (February 2026) and $750 million (August 2026) programmes, so the November 2026 count may be lower.
